summary: 42-year-old male skier suffered a knee injury skiing the second bowl on Axtel; call came in at 1:37 p.m. while CBSAR was covering the Gothic Mountain Tour. Local guide Steve Banks and five students from an AMGA ski-guide course built a rescue sled and got the patient partway down before ~8 CBSAR members met them with a Cascade toboggan; an uphaul system raised him to Kebler Pass Road, snowmobile trailer to the trailhead, then personal vehicle to a local clinic; response complete by 4:30 p.m.; no life-threatening injuries, hospital transport not required.
location: Second bowl, Axtel (off Kebler Pass Road)
notes: Date inferred: CBN March-2017 article says the injury happened "on Saturday" while CBSAR was covering the Gothic Mountain Tour; the 11th Annual Gothic Mountain Tour was Saturday, Feb 25, 2017 (CBN Benchtalk, Feb 24, 2017). Field fix (run 691): incident_type vehicle → injury — skiing knee injury with snowmobile-trailer transport, not a vehicle incident.
